scope: Visual and numeric evaluation, not a new implementation or full endurance certification.

fullAppPlayback.qualificationNote: Mixed close/regional/world zoom; repeated Home actions mean much of this run is overview. Frame intervals are requestAnimationFrame observations, not isolated GPU times. Heap excludes worker heaps, GPU and native browser allocations.

numericModelCheck.scope: Actual Chrome end-save. Building-body centers/corners tested against 0.5-map-unit samples of the same river curves/widths used by the renderer. Center hits are clear conflicts; corner hits are an approximate footprint check, not an exact polygon union. Sample buildings are virtual plans, not all simultaneously visible.

mobile.note: Viewport emulation in desktop Chrome, not phone-hardware performance.

visualAssessment.verdict: Useful visual foundation, not finished against the alive-world brief.
strengths: Recognizable farms, quarries, workshops and docks; town houses remain modest in height.
Denser forests and climate-dependent foliage make land uses easier to read.
Crop textures persist across zoom; observed activity is disposable and economic totals remain conserved.

findings.title: Activity buildings intersect rivers
findings.observed: Farms visibly overlap the river in the generated Greyport coast. Numeric center/footprint checks corroborate the issue.
findings.recommendation: Use the same sampled river-clearance and footprint checks already used by cityLayout, and site farms/workshops along dry access paths.

findings.title: Simulation throughput is far below the requested speed
findings.observed: At requested 12x playback, the timed interval published four monthly advances in 120.23 seconds. This does not demonstrate massive full-engine scaling.
findings.recommendation: Profile monthly phases and snapshot construction on this saved world; the spatial worker pool alone does not parallelize the entire economy.

findings.title: Intermittent long update stalls
findings.observed: Four frame intervals exceeded one second; the worst in the timed run was 1781.97 ms. Whole-world paint calls reached 1908.56 ms in the wider graphics collection.
findings.recommendation: Profile and split expensive snapshot-to-scene work, retaining static geometry and changing only affected tiles. An A/B run is needed to attribute the incremental cost of the new feature.

findings.title: The countryside still looks systematically stamped
findings.observed: Farmhouse/barn pairs repeat near source-cell centers with narrow orientation variation; straight connections and dense crop rectangles expose the underlying grid. This is visible in generated geography, independently of the controlled fixture.
findings.recommendation: Vary compound count, orientation, age, clustering and access according to local roads, terrain and demand; retain undeveloped margins and irregular field boundaries.

findings.title: Crop texture competes with geography at regional scale
findings.observed: High-frequency yellow field patches dominate the background and surround some woodland in the regional view.
findings.recommendation: Fade field coverage and boundaries with distance, while preserving close-scale furrows and soil variation.

detector.note: Static markup scan does not validate WebGL scenery or its economic model.

discardedEvidence.reason: Recording opened a duplicate tab whose restored camera was at overview. It failed the intended close-view condition and is excluded.
The recording tab reset the camera; not accepted as evidence of a product LOD defect.

limits: No before/after baseline, so whole-scene cost cannot all be attributed to the latest commit.
Two minutes of playback and 30 seconds of close panning do not establish long-run stability.
External state-agent generation was disabled; paid transport command rules were not manually exercised in this browser pass.
The cold Node projection measurement is from the month-eight save and is not comparable to the earlier warmed month-one measurements.
No product source changed during this evaluation.
